notes: Added missing schema, rotation core logic, and expiration enforcement stories to complete lifecycle coverage.

change_log.note: Adds schema definition for lifecycle tracking
Adds rotation implementation missing from prior set
Adds expiration handling and cleanup mechanism
Defines issuance contract and validation constraints

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Schema & Storage Model
stories.description: Design and implement the persistent schema for bearer tokens including fields for token_id, hashed_token, issued_at, expires_at, rotated_from, revoked_at, and status flags to support lifecycle tracking.

stories.title: Token Rotation Core Logic
stories.description: Implement secure token rotation logic that issues a new token, links it to the prior token via rotated_from, and invalidates the previous token while preventing reuse.

stories.title: Token Expiration Enforcement & Cleanup
stories.description: Implement expiration checks based on expires_at during validation and introduce a lightweight cleanup mechanism to mark or purge expired tokens without impacting request latency.

stories.title: Token Issuance Contract & Validation Rules
stories.description: Define and enforce the contract for token issuance including TTL configuration, hashing requirements, uniqueness constraints, and validation rules to ensure tokens meet security standards at creation time.
